function.arguments: {"thought":"The vulnerability fix commit b7484d2 adds a top-level convert_colorspace check that Alpha plane width/height equal the image width/height. In the local v1.6.2 color_conversion_fuzzer always creates alpha full-size, so a direct malformed alpha-plane-size fuzzer input cannot be expressed through this harness. The real project path for decoded HEIF input can create a mismatched alpha plane: heif_context.cc decodes an auxiliary alpha image independently and transfers its Y plane as heif_channel_Alpha without checking sizes. Subsequent decode_image color conversion can read alpha rows using the primary dimensions. Therefore the candidate probably needs to be a HEIF file with a primary image and smaller alpha aux image. Building such a HEIF by hand is complex; before that, try likely OSS-Fuzz color conversion candidate shapes that exercise alpha copying in conversion, because submit feedback can guide whether benchmark target is harness-level."}
function.name: think
